args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Fix
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the FIN-212 requirement.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even` (e.g. 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

Reviewer: @alex
